name: Caribe Resort
description: Caribe Resort is a premier destination property located on the Alabama Gulf Coast in Orange Beach. The staff and management of Caribe Resort are dedicated to making your vacation a life-long dream. We offer hundreds of vacation rentals ranging from 2 to 4+ bedroom condominiums, all fully equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. You won't have to go far to enjoy relaxing amenities such as the lazy river, pools, slides, saunas, hot tubs, tennis courts, and more. Our property features complimentary boat slips for guests, an on-site marina, and access to world-class dining at Cobalt Restaurant. Whether you're planning a family vacation, romantic getaway, group retreat, or special event, Caribe Resort provides the perfect blend of luxury and leisure. We are within minutes of many popular locations, stores, and restaurants, and provide complimentary trolley service from 8:00 am to 8:00 pm to the public beach access point and throughout the property.
